entry.author: AUT - Auckland University of Technology
entry.summary:
What if your “normal day” at uni turned into a football challenge with Auckland FC players? 👀⚽
That’s exactly what happened when Auckland FC teamed up with AUT to surprise our students.
Who got stuck in, and who was caught slipping? Big respect to Captain Hiroki Sakai, Lachie Brook and Callan Elliot for being great sports and stepping up with our students.

👉 Subscribe for more and check out AUT on socials.
